row.evidence: StackHawk's SSO/SAML docs ("available on the StackHawk Scale plan") describe only SAML sign-in where "new SAML users ... will be auto-provisioned"; no SCIM endpoint appears in the docs, API spec or help centre.
row.notes: Status moved from unknown to none by absence (medium confidence): pricing page, docs sitemap, OpenAPI spec and help-centre sitemap were searched and none mention SCIM; the only automation is SAML JIT on the Scale plan (Talk to us). Pricing changed since June: the Pro $49/contributor/mo (20-contributor minimum) plan is gone; the page now lists Wingman $10/user/mo and Scale (Talk to us), with 'Teams, roles, SSO' only on Scale. Wingman billing period is not stated. Okta's OIN app is SAML-only. The public API can list members and manage teams but cannot invite or remove users; the audit API is Enterprise-tier only.
